name: Kimpton Riverplace Hotel
insider_take: Portland's only waterfront boutique hotel sits on the banks of the Willamette River, where you can watch working tugboats navigate the same waters Lewis & Clark once explored.
whats_special: This historic property occupies the former RiverPlace Marina site and features Portland's unique "Keep Portland Weird" culture with locally-sourced amenities and artwork from Pacific Northwest artists. The hotel's Three Degrees Waterfront Bar & Grill offers one of the city's best riverside dining experiences, while the Tom McCall Waterfront Park stretches right outside your door.
pro_tip: Book a river-view room on the upper floors for stunning sunrise views over Mount Hood, and time your visit during the summer Rose Festival when dragon boat races happen right outside the hotel.
dont_miss: Take the hotel's complimentary bikes along the Eastbank Esplanade for panoramic city skyline views, or stroll five minutes to the iconic Powell's City of Books - the world's largest independent bookstore covering an entire city block with over one million books.
pros: Prime riverfront location with scenic Willamette River views
Boutique charm with personalized Kimpton hospitality and pet-friendly amenities
Walking distance to downtown Portland attractions and waterfront parks
Complimentary evening wine hour and morning coffee service
cons: Limited on-site parking with valet service required
Smaller boutique property with fewer amenities than large resort hotels
